notes: Current Clos de Vougeot / Clos Vougeot specification homologated 25 March 2026. This supersedes and abrogates the 2011 decree. Maturity, alcohol and exact calendar release rules are machine-executable in the legal-spec layer.

clos_vougeot_masaa_2026.authority: Ministère de l'agriculture, de l'agro-alimentaire et de la souveraineté alimentaire
clos_vougeot_masaa_2026.title: Cahier des charges de l'appellation d'origine contrôlée Clos de Vougeot ou Clos Vougeot
clos_vougeot_masaa_2026.scope: Current specification homologated 25 March 2026: red still wine; Pinot Noir principal with accessory varieties only in mixed plantings; 198 g/L minimum must sugar; 11.5% minimum natural alcohol; 42 hL/ha yield; 49 hL/ha rendement butoir; <=0.4 g/L malic acid; <=2 g/L fermentable sugar; <=14.5% total alcohol after enrichment; elevage through 15 June; consumer release from 30 June of the following year.

clos_vougeot_legifrance_2026.authority: Journal officiel de la République française / Légifrance
clos_vougeot_legifrance_2026.title: Arrêté du 25 mars 2026 homologuant le cahier des charges de l'AOC Clos de Vougeot ou Clos Vougeot
clos_vougeot_legifrance_2026.scope: Homologates the 2026 specification and abrogates decree no. 2011-1332.

specs.notes: Current 2026 law. Conservative 100% Pinot Noir positive path: Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris are accessories only in mixed vineyard plantings, limited to 15% per parcel. Rendement butoir is 49 hL/ha and is retained in source metadata until the simulation adds authorized-overrun mechanics.
